## Your Trusted Concrete Pool Builder Since 2007

Your backyard has potential that only a custom concrete pool can unlock. Whether you’re dreaming of a simple rectangular pool for lap swimming, an elaborate resort-style design with waterfalls and spas, or something uniquely tailored to your family’s needs, SpringLake Pools & Masonry has the expertise to make it reality.

We’ve been building custom concrete pools throughout Dallas, PA and northeastern Pennsylvania since 2007. Our experience covers every challenge you’ll encounter in this region – from excavating through the rocky ledge near Bear Creek to working with the clay soil conditions in Back Mountain, to designing pools that handle Pennsylvania’s freeze-thaw cycles year after year.

Your pool should be a permanent extension of your home, not a temporary addition that looks out of place. Let our construction expertise create the custom concrete pool that transforms your backyard into your family’s favorite destination.

[Concrete Pool Builder](https://springlakepools.com/concrete-pool-builder/)

![Premier Custom Concrete Pool Builder](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/IMG_2278_Original-1024x767.jpeg)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/spring-lake-pools-spa-and-pools-premium-services.jpeg)

## Inground Pool Installation

Building pools in Dallas, PA means dealing with Pennsylvania’s freeze-thaw cycles. We’ve seen too many pool disasters from contractors who don’t understand our climate. Your custom concrete pool needs to handle temperature swings from 90°F summers to -10°F winters.

Our team specializes in inground pool installation using advanced concrete techniques. Every pool starts with proper excavation that accounts for our rocky soil conditions. We’ve installed pools everywhere from the hills of Dallas Township to the flatter areas near Misericordia University.

[Inground Pool Installation](https://springlakepools.com/swimming-pool-contractor/inground-pool-installation/)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/gunite-pool-construction-dallas-pa.jpg)

## Gunite Pool Construction

Gunite pool construction is our specialty because it works best in Pennsylvania weather. This spray-applied concrete creates the strongest pool shell possible. We’ve built gunite pools that are still perfect after 20+ years of harsh winters.

The gunite process lets us create any shape you want. We’ve built pools that curve around mature oak trees, fit into narrow Back Mountain lots, and work with steep slopes near Lake Silkworth. Concrete pool construction gives you options that fiberglass pools can’t match.

[Gunite Pool Construction](https://springlakepools.com/swimming-pool-contractor/gunite-pool-construction/)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/pool-design-and-planning-in-clarks-summit-pa.jpg)

## Custom Pool Design and Build

Every custom pool design starts with your backyard and your family’s needs. We measure slopes, check sight lines from your house, and plan around existing landscaping. Our masonry expertise allows us to create everything from stone walls and retaining structures to elegant coping, pool decks, fire pits, water features, and complete outdoor kitchens—seamlessly blending durability with design.

[Custom Pool and Design](https://springlakepools.com/swimming-pool-contractor/custom-pool-design-and-build/)

###### Home Pools

## Details Matter

From lighting, textures, and color palettes to the efficient use of space, SpringLake Pools understands the significance of your investment and the importance of every detail of your outdoor living project. From your first design consult to the champagne toast at completion, we will communicate clearly, interface often and dedicate our time to the details.

[Get in touch](https://springlakepools.com/swimming-pool-contractor/#consult)

![High-Quality Construction Process](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLakePools-Construction-768x1024.jpeg)

If you can dream it, we can design it! SpringLake Pools works closely with you to create outdoor living spaces that fit your lifestyle and integrate seamlessly into the unique aspects of your property.

## Poolside paradise

Our spas, whether stand-alone or integrated along with the pool, offer year-round enjoyment. From relieving stress to soothing sore muscles, warming up on a chilly night or cooling off during the day, romantic evenings for two or toasting for ten, the addition of a spa creates the core backyard get-away. Schedule a design consultation today!

[Schedule Now!](https://springlakepools.com/swimming-pool-contractor/#consult)

## Service Areas Throughout Northeastern Pennsylvania

We serve [Dallas](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-dallas-pa/), [Back Mountain](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-back-mountain-pa/), Shavertown, [Bear Creek](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-bear-creek-pa/), Trucksville, [Mountain Top](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-mountain-top-pa/), and surrounding communities in Luzerne County. Our crews also work in [Clarks Summit](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-clarks-summit-pa/), [Wilkes Barre](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-wilkes-barre-pa/), [Scranton](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-scranton-pa/), Waverly, and other parts of Lackawanna County.

From Harvey’s Lake to Sweet Valley, from Tunkhannock to the Poconos ( [Tannersville](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-tannersville-pa/) and [Blakeslee](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-blakeslee-pa/)) we know the terrain, soil conditions, and local requirements. Every area has different challenges for pool construction and service.

[Learn More](https://springlakepools.com/services/)

Don’t trust your backyard oasis to out-of-town contractors or low-bid companies. Choose the local pool builder that Dallas families have trusted for over a decade.
